title: Hierarchical Spatiotemporal World Modeling with Content-Adaptive Spatial Addressing
title_zh: 具有内容自适应空间寻址的层次化时空世界建模
abstract_en: Long-horizon world modeling in partially observable environments requires compact memories that preserve spatial structure despite accumulated localization drift. Inspired by hippocampal episodic and spatial memory and the multi-periodic coding of entorhinal grid cells, we propose HiSTFormer, a hierarchical spatiotemporal world model, which adopts a layer-wise organization of local temporal RoPE and multi-periodic spatial RoPE, together with content-conditioned address offsets, to capture recent temporal context and long-range spatial structure. A fixed-capacity memory keeps KV storage and per-step attention cost bounded as the sequence grows. On MemoryMaze and HM3D, HiSTFormer outperforms strong world-model baselines within the training sequence length and generalizes substantially better to prediction horizons far beyond those seen during training, while using a compact model. The hierarchical spatiotemporal design remains effective across deeper Transformer stacks, with consistent gains as depth increases. These results show that hierarchical spatiotemporal organization and content-adaptive spatial addressing provide effective inductive biases for efficient long-horizon world modeling.
abstract_zh: 在部分可观测环境中进行长时域世界建模，需要用紧凑的记忆在定位漂移不断累积的情况下保留空间结构。受海马体的情景记忆和空间记忆以及内嗅皮层网格细胞的多周期编码启发，本文提出层次化时空世界模型 HiSTFormer。该模型分层组织局部时间 RoPE 和多周期空间 RoPE，并根据内容调整空间寻址偏移，以兼顾近期时间上下文与远距离空间结构。固定容量记忆使键值（KV）存储开销和单步注意力计算成本不会随序列增长而持续增加。在 MemoryMaze 和 HM3D 上，紧凑的 HiSTFormer 在训练序列长度范围内优于强世界模型基线，并在远超训练长度的预测时域上展现出更强的泛化能力。随着 Transformer 堆栈加深，层次化时空设计仍能带来稳定收益。
key_points_zh: 分层组织局部时间 RoPE 和多周期空间 RoPE，分别捕捉近期时间上下文和远距离空间结构。
根据内容调整空间寻址偏移，帮助在定位漂移累积时保留空间结构。
固定容量记忆为 KV 存储开销和单步注意力计算成本设定上限。
在 MemoryMaze 和 HM3D 上，训练长度范围内的预测优于强基线，远超训练长度时的泛化优势更明显；加深 Transformer 后仍有稳定收益。
